name: Bank of Baroda
title: Bank of Baroda - 532134 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bank of Baroda raised FY27 loan growth guidance to 12-14% and NIM to 2.75-2.95%, but Q4 NIM of 2.89% leans partly on IT refund interest and deposit costs are sticky at 4.78%.

triggers.label: Loan growth guide 11-13% → 12-14%
triggers.quote: The loan growth earlier we had given a guidance of 11 to 13 %, now we are upsizing that to 12 to 14 %.

triggers.label: Cost of deposits sticky at 4.78%
triggers.quote: the cost of deposit is going to be sticky. I mean, as I said, the cost of deposit further moderation going by the current scenario, we are not looking at.

triggers.label: Credit cost FY27 below 0.60%
triggers.quote: The credit cost for the full year is going to be less than 0.60%.

guidance.quote: The loan growth earlier we had given a guidance of 11 to 13 %, now we are upsizing that to 12 to 14 %.
Deposit growth guidance for the last year was 9 to 11 %, that we are improving to 10 to 12 %.
the NIM guidance has been 2.75 to 2.95% for the full year.
the ROA is going to be more than 1 %
the slippage ratio we continue to maintain at 1 to 1.25 %
The credit cost for the full year is going to be less than 0.60%.
I'll continue to have the same normalized guidance of Rs. 750-800 crores.
we'll be adding something around 4 to 5,000 headcounts in this year.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are given a guidance of 11-13 % and we achieved 16.2%.
the deposit growth for this quarter and the full year has been almost at 12 %.
compared to our guidance of Rs. 750-850 odd crores, we saw a substantial increase.

red_flags.label: Q4 NIM aided by IT refund interest
red_flags.quote: there is also element of the IT refund which also contributed to some extent.

red_flags.label: Middle East exposure watch
red_flags.quote: But yes, particularly in Middle East operation, we need to be slightly watchful for a couple of quarters.

red_flags.label: Bulk deposits up to 19%
red_flags.quote: It is slightly increased to 19 point some percentage for March.

evasions.quote: No, actually, we do not have a number, I do not have a number, you can offline, get a number.
as on today, I do not have a number with regard to the ECL impact.
as a policy of the Bank, which the Board has laid out, bilateral account we don't discuss.
